stem.en: You can walk on a dry floor without slipping. On a wet polished floor, your foot slips. Why?

text.en: The wet floor pushes your foot forwards harder.

feedback.en: A wet polished floor gives less force on your foot, not more.

text.en: Your foot pushes the floor backwards, and friction pushes you forwards. A wet polished floor gives much less friction.

feedback.en: Right. You move forward because friction from the floor pushes your foot forwards. With little friction, the foot slides back.

text.en: Your weight becomes smaller on a wet floor.

feedback.en: Your weight does not change. The friction between your foot and the floor changes.

explanation.en: To walk, your foot pushes the floor backwards, and friction from the floor pushes your foot forwards. A wet polished floor gives much less friction, so your foot slides back.

hints.en: Which force from the floor pushes you forwards when you walk?
